propositions: The Cloud comment differ's body-equality dedup key uses truncate_comment_body (32767 char plain limit) while the send path uses AdfCodec.fit_outbound (32000 byte serialized ADF limit with marker budget), causing over-length comments to never match and re-post on every pass.

For a 43200-char body on current main, the comparison key is 32767 chars but the landed body is 31753 chars with first divergence at index 31725, proving the two truncation paths are structurally incompatible for the over-length regime.

The regression was introduced by commit 27b868ba55 (emersed-specific-mutt), which moved the send path to codec.fit_outbound but left _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment on truncate_comment_body, violating the stated invariant that both paths must share one helper.

The fix restores fit_comment to return the marker-free text the send path actually lands by composing fit_comment_as_sent with the flag-governed AdfCodec, keeping _diff_comments, Data Center, and comment_limits.py untouched.
The dedup key is computed in memory each pass and never persisted, so no stored keys need migration and the change can only add skips, never remove them, eliminating re-post risk.
Existing tests that pinned the old truncate_comment_body model must be retargeted to derive their send-side expectation from the real acli_cli_ops.add_comment path to prevent future silent staleness.
